archetypes.name: dyn-bg-wait-lint
archetypes.rationale: Changed static bg-wait coverage rules and markdown launch directives.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the bg-wait coverage lint changes for false positives and false negatives. Check that placeholder-bearing real launches are now linted, the brainstorm mapping is narrow enough for the two intended launch shapes, and the /research exclusion is explicit rather than accidental. Verify the new brainstorm directive lines remain close enough to their fences for the existing nearest-fence matcher. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
